# libheif (WebAssembly build)

`libheif-bundle.js` is the WebAssembly build of [libheif](https://github.com/strukturag/libheif)
(with the libde265 HEVC decoder) from the npm package
[libheif-js 1.23.5](https://www.npmjs.com/package/libheif-js) (file `libheif-wasm/libheif-bundle.js`),
copied unchanged.

libheif and libde265 are licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License v3 (see `LICENSE-libheif`);
the libheif-js packaging is covered by `LICENSE-libheif-js`. To update, replace the file with the same file
from a newer libheif-js release.
